resources.string: No-Reels uses the Android Accessibility Service solely to detect short-form video feeds (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and TikTok), display the live top counter overlay, and protect your active focus lock. All processing runs 100% offline on your device; no personal or screen data is ever collected, stored externally, or transmitted.
Protects No-Reels from impulsive uninstallation while Strict Lock is active. You can unlock uninstallation at any time inside No-Reels by completing an Emergency Unlock challenge.
